summary: Tested passe A/B/C/D: infra offline Dexie+syncQueue, crons publics (bad-payer-scan, voice-purge), page /containers/labels, rebrand BevidLogo. 4/4 backend tests PASS. Frontend: /login BEVID visible, sidebar BEVID logo visible, sync indicator 'À jour' after login, /containers/labels loads (24-label sheet), print button toggles disabled/enabled correctly, offline hook does not crash the app and SyncIndicator switches to 'Hors ligne'.

minor.issue: Email input not lowercased before find_one; admin_create_user lowercases stored email, so users typing mixed-case at login get 401. Trim+lower recommended.
Response omits 'snapshot_at' (only 'server_time'), while frontend db.js saveSnapshot expects snapshot.snapshot_at → stored as undefined in Dexie meta.

integration_issues.issue: When context goes offline, dashboard GET calls (KPIs, top products, etc.) raise unhandled AxiosError 'Network Error' — visible as React dev-overlay 'Uncaught runtime errors'. postOffline() only covers POST mutations; GETs have no .catch on some callers. Not a crash in production but noisy in dev.

issues: Recharts warning 'width(-1) and height(-1)' spams console — chart container missing minWidth/minHeight (cosmetic).

action_items: Consider lowercasing email in /api/auth/login (defensive, matches admin_create_user behavior).
Add 'snapshot_at' field to /api/sync/bootstrap response (used by frontend saveSnapshot).
Wrap dashboard fetches in try/catch or silence AxiosError network failures when navigator.onLine === false to avoid React dev-overlay noise.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py file is 3397 lines — still growing; should be split (auth, sync, cron, admin, etc.).
syncQueue.js flushQueue: on non-4xx error it breaks the loop (correct back-off), but there is no exponential delay; setInterval 60s is the only retry cadence. OK for MVP.
QRLabels.jsx: 'items.find(c => c.id === id)' inside render loop is O(n²) — negligible at n=24 but consider a Map.
api.js postOffline swallows non-network errors correctly, but the same defensive layer isn't applied to GET requests → dashboard shows 'Uncaught' overlay when offline.
seed_data_creation: Created ephemeral commercial users test_commercial_<uuid8>@example.com via /api/admin/users for segregation test. They are marked active=false at teardown; not deleted from users collection (no DELETE endpoint used to avoid interference).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_iter6_crons_bootstrap.py -v -o addopts=''. Backend login response key is 'token' (not 'access_token'). Dexie DB name is 'bevid_offline' with stores establishments/products/sync_queue/meta. window.__SYNC_PENDING__ is updated every ~2s by SyncIndicator + startSyncListener. Cron endpoints POST /api/cron/{bad-payer-scan,voice-purge} are unauthenticated by design (called by scheduler). QRLabels page requires containers to exist in DB — test DB has 1 container available.
rca of the issue: No blocking issues. Two minor deviations noted: (1) /auth/login case-sensitivity in email lookup; (2) /sync/bootstrap missing snapshot_at key. Neither impacts the passe under test but should be fixed before broader release.
